The suite went from 228 s to 52-65 s unloaded and passes with zero timeouts at host load 86, but a synthetic load of 140 was not run because creating CPU hogs was denied.

criteria.criterion: The entry world fade first step is no larger than the previously accepted level (about 2.3x the neighbour median luminance step) and the fade stays monotone, shown by a before and after frame measurement.
criteria.evidence: Cause: the hero-to-world swap is a long frame (47 ms) counted in full as the first fade step. Fix: stepEnvTween caps the first step of an opening tween at ENV_FIRST_STEP_S = 10 ms (components/game/tween.ts), used by GameScene. Browser per-frame: before 7.05x/8.94x/7.58x the median of steps 2-11; after 0.86x/0.88x/0.85x; monotone true. Unit test in tween.test.ts (first step <= 1.25x median with a 47 ms hitch; uncapped 2.8x). Dev server, not production build.

criteria.criterion: Jumping at the tower passage mouth keeps the avatar head in frame on every sampled frame in portrait 390x844, landscape 844x390 and desktop 1440x900, without near-plane clipping or geometry occlusion, with a regression test that fails on b9776c1.
criteria.evidence: Cause: leaving the passage, rule 5 pulls the camera to the mouth while the avatar is airborne 1 to 2 m away, so the crown leaves the view (ndc y 1.09 to 1.14). Fix: rule 6 frameHead in components/game/followCamera.ts tilts the aim to keep the crown (CAMERA.headTop 1.85 m) inside the view less CAMERA.frameMarginDeg 4 degrees; camera position unchanged; off during entry/exit blends. followCamera.framing.test.ts (3 headings x walk/run x 6 jump points, all 3 viewports, near+0.3 m, no blocking geometry) failed 6/6 on base, passes now. Verified in the Rapier harness, not by eye in a browser.

criteria.criterion: npm test passes with zero timeouts when run while the host is under heavy synthetic CPU load (record load average), and its unloaded duration does not grow.
criteria.evidence: Synthetic load generation was denied by the permission classifier and not worked around. npm test passed twice under natural host load 46.8 to 92.9 and 86.0 to 86.2, exit 0, 1339 passed, zero 'timed out'. Root cause addressed: the 226 s single-file bodyClearance matrix was split into a shared harness and per-face files so the runner parallelises; unloaded duration fell from 228 s to 52 s; vitest testTimeout/hookTimeout 60 s is only a safety net.

assumptions: The avatar crown is 1.85 m above the soles (capsule 1.81 m plus margin); no per-asset measurement was made.
The Rapier harness projection of the crown with vertical fov 55 stands in for the three viewports (aspect does not change the vertical crop).
node_modules in the worktree is git-ignored.
The temporary diagnostic line in GameScene.tsx and the before toggle were removed before the final runs.
questions: Synthetic CPU load at 140 was denied by the permission classifier; a run at that load needs explicit authorization.
decisionsProposed: Opening env tweens consume at most 10 ms of the first visible step (ENV_FIRST_STEP_S): the swap hitch only delays the fade instead of becoming its first step.
Camera rule 6 (keep the crown in frame by tilting the aim, never moving the camera) belongs in the followCamera contract next to rules 1 to 5.
Heavy campus matrices are written one case per wall face and split over several test files; vitest testTimeout 60 s is a safety net, not the fix.
lessonsProposed: Per-frame canvas luminance via gl.readPixels in a wrapped requestAnimationFrame measures every rendered frame; CDP screencast drops frames above load 100 and cannot resolve a fade.
A single long test file runs on one vitest worker: split by pose/face into files so wall time and per-case time both shrink.
Check the whole tween chain when a fade pops: a linearised opacity combined with eased fog, clear alpha and lights, and a long swap frame counted as dt.
